intro: We are a three-person, cross-disciplinary team building Sinkronized for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

members.name: Reshma Panibhate
members.bio: Processes NISAR radar observations, checks signal quality and compares measurements with published Arizona water-resource records.
members.education: Master’s in Robotics and Autonomous Systems (Artificial Intelligence) · Arizona State University

members.name: Mansi Ganga Nayak
members.bio: Builds the web atlas that brings study areas, time-linked displacement charts and supporting map layers into one interactive experience.
members.education: Master of Computer Science (Cybersecurity) · Arizona State University

members.name: Ritam Bhabak
members.bio: Shapes the visual narrative and geographic context connecting ground movement with Arizona’s water, infrastructure and ecosystems.
members.education: Master of Architecture · Arizona State University
